KELAS KENDERAAN

Kelas 1: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan tiga atau empat roda

(kecuali teksi dan bas)

Kelas 2: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan lima atau enam roda

(kecuali bas)

Kelas 3: Kenderaan yang mempunyai tiga gandar atau lebih (kecuali bas)

Kelas 4: Teksi

Kelas 5: Bas

Bagi maksud mengira bilangan gandar dan roda sesebuah kenderaan, gandar dan

roda mana-mana treler yang ditarik oleh kenderaan itu hendaklah dikira sebagai

sebahagian daripada gandar dan roda kenderaan itu.".

Penggantian Jadual Ketiga Belas

4. Perintah ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan Jadual Ketiga Belas dengan

Jadual yang berikut:

"JADUAL KETIGA BELAS

PETA LEBUH RAYA JURU-JALAN DUTA-BUKIT RAJA, LEBUH RAYA UTARA SELATAN

HUBUNGAN TENGAH DAN LEBUH RAYA KUALA LUMPUR-JOHOR BAHRU

".

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/1 Jld.20; PN(PU2)426/LXVII]

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(JURU-JALAN DUTA-BUKIT RAJA EXPRESSWAY, NORTH SOUTH EXPRESSWAY

CENTRAL LINK AND KUALA LUMPUR-JOHORE BAHRU EXPRESSWAY)

(AMENDMENT) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the

Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the

following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private

Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Juru-Jalan Duta-Bukit Raja Expressway,

North South Expressway Central Link and Kuala Lumpur-Johore Bahru

Expressway) (Amendment) Order 2019.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 6 September 2019.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Juru-Jalan

Duta-Bukit Raja Expressway, North South Expressway Central Link and

Kuala Lumpur-Johore Bahru Expressway) Order 2002 [P.U. (A) 171/2002], which

is referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in paragraph 2 —

(a) in subparagraph (1), by substituting for the words

"Third Schedule G" the words "Third Schedule H"; and

(b) in subsubparagraph (2)(a), by substituting for the words

"Third Schedule G" the words "Third Schedule H".

New Third Schedule H

3. The principal Order is amended by inserting after Third Schedule G the

following Schedule:

CLASSES OF VEHICLES

Class 1: Vehicles having two axles and three or four wheels (excluding taxis

and buses)

Class 2: Vehicles having two axles and five or six wheels (excluding buses)

Class 3: Vehicles having three axles or more (excluding buses)

Class 4: Taxis

Class 5: Buses

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle,

the axles and wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part

of the axles and wheels of the vehicle.".

the following Schedule:

EXPRESSWAY CENTRAL LINK AND KUALA LUMPUR-JOHORE BAHRU EXPRESSWAY
